grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 13014 and dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so every source row is already a distinct event with no exact duplicates to collapse. observed_hour_utc has distinct_count 4341 and airport_code has distinct_count 3, and 3*4341=13023 is within a handful of rows of 13014 (a few station-hours are simply missing, not duplicated), so the pair (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) identifies one hourly observation at one airport; the derived identity over that tuple is used as the transaction grain and duplicate_row_rate 0.0 confirms no rows collide on it.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: The three-letter NYC airport code (EWR, JFK, LGA per distinct_values) that identifies which station recorded the observation; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: The UTC timestamp of the hourly observation, sampled on exact hour boundaries (e.g. 2013-01-01T06:00:00) from 2013-01-01 to 2013-07-01, with null_rate 0.0; this is the event clock for the category.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: The local calendar date of the observation (min 2013-01-01, max 2013-06-30, distinct_count 181), carried as-is alongside the UTC timestamp; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: The local hour of day (0-23, distinct_count 24) labeling when the observation occurred in local time; a label, not a quantity to sum, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit (operator context), ranging 10.94 to 93.92 across 130 distinct values, a continuous measurement with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in degrees Fahrenheit, ranging -9.94 to 73.94 across 119 distinct values, a continuous measurement with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage, ranging 12.74 to 100.0 across 2178 distinct values, a continuous measurement with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in compass degrees (0 to 360, 37 distinct values); nullable with null_rate 0.016828, likely reflecting calm-wind observations where direction is undefined.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in miles per hour, ranging 0.0 to 1048.36058 across 36 distinct values; nullable with a very low null_rate of 0.000154.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in miles per hour (16.11092 to 62.14212, 35 distinct values); mostly absent with null_rate 0.745505, consistent with gusts only being recorded when conditions are gusty.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches, ranging 0.0 to 1.06 across 50 distinct values, a continuous measurement with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars, ranging 983.8 to 1038.4 across 430 distinct values; nullable with null_rate 0.114953, likely from sensor gaps at some stations/hours.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility in miles, a capped set of 20 distinct values from 0.0 to 10.0, a continuous measurement with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: The full airport name from the OurAirports join (John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport), a stable per-airport label with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: The municipality of the airport (New York or Newark per distinct_values), a stable per-airport label with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: The airport's elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21 across 3 distinct values), a fixed attribute of the airport rather than a measured quantity, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: The airport's longest runway length in feet (7002, 11000, or 14511 across 3 distinct values), a fixed attribute of the airport, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: A capture/ingestion timestamp clustered within seconds on 2026-09-02 (3 distinct values), distinct from the observation's own event time and so carried as a dimension, with null_rate 0.0.

category_description: One row represents a single hourly weather observation recorded at one of the three NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), joined to that airport's static OurAirports attributes, as named and typed by the silver contract.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, naming its time column, grain, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that consumes mapping contracts to emit gold models.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; only the approved contract drives the modeling engine.
limitations: The mapping does not filter or correct any rows: nullable fields such as wind_gust_mph (null_rate 0.745505), pressure_mb (null_rate 0.114953), and wind_dir_degrees (null_rate 0.016828) are passed through as nullable measures, and any decision to exclude or impute missing weather readings is left to downstream consumers; the airport join's completeness is asserted by the operator context, not independently verified here.
